_note: Mani's phone, Part 1. Facts come from docs/story/part1-greyhaven-screenplay.md Ep 1 (voicemail Sun 23:52, Nila's 'not on the phone', Mani's text to Tess in Scene 3, Tess's reply in Scene 5, Amma and Appa calling, Nila's baby/first-broadcast/convocation photos). Entries marked design:true are short invented filler, not canon, and may change. Tanglish text carries a subtitle (shown under the bubble). 'unlock' is empty (always there), a flag name, or 'clue:<id>' / 'journal:<id>'; OOTPhone.notify_message(thread, id) delivers a message regardless.

messages.text: Anna, diya ellam nee kondu vaa, inga kidaikaadhu.
messages.subtitle: Anna, bring the diyas yourself, you can't get them here.
OK, I already got them from Amma.

messages.text: Oru vishayam paakanum. Nerla solren, phone-la vendaam.
messages.subtitle: There's something I need you to see. I'll tell you in person, not on the phone.
What is it? OK, I'll be there Tuesday.

messages.text: Hi Tess, it's Mani, Nila's brother. Is she around? Coming up today.
haven't seen her since sunday night. thought she was with u?? her phone is here at the flat
Kanna, call pannu. Nila phone edukkala.
messages.subtitle: Kanna, call me. Nila isn't picking up.

messages.text: Kanna, laptop open pannu, Appa-vum irukkaar.
messages.subtitle: Kanna, open your laptop, Appa is here too.
